''See also: [[Ragnarus Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnation]] is a powerful, noble entity that functions as a force of nature. While possessing immense strength, these beings are prone to madness if they remain in the world for extended periods, behaving much like feral animals. The [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnation]] currently rules over [[Damasca]], a city that has been held in imprisonment. This entity is characterized by a straightforward nature, seeking power regardless of the cost and utilizing direct methods to destroy targets. Its motivations are driven by a desire to transform the world into [[Valinhall]], a realm defined by constant combat and meritocracy where every individual is tested through battle. Historically, the [[Incarnations]] were guarded by [[Elysia]] before [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] took over that role. They are kept contained by artifacts known as [[Trees]], and the destruction of these [[Trees]] brings all [[Incarnations]] closer to freedom. One of the few ways to return them to their confinement is through a specific seed, unless they are intercepted by a [[Ragnarus Traveler]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Once sealed within a dungeon beneath the [[Blue Room]], the [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnation]] is an individual who may have trapped themselves or been imprisoned in [[Cana]]. [[Simon]] suspected that this immortal being held the [[Overlord of Cana]] under his control before the entity declared his intention to attack [[Enosh]]. During a confrontation, [[Simon]] struck the creature's shield with his shoulder. Although being sealed beneath a [[Hanging Tree]] is considered a [[Fate|fate]] worse than death for such an entity, the [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnation]] eventually departed, an event that resulted in the surrender of the [[Damascans]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] is a person who may have been trapped in [[Cana]] or trapped themselves.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17">''City of Light'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Simon]] considers the possibility that the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] has the [[Overlord of Cana]] under his control.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Simon]] hit the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]]’s shield with his shoulder.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|It is a [[Fate|fate]] worse than death for a [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] to be sealed beneath a [[Hanging Tree]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}</li>
